qualifications: All rows derive from the accepted ordinary workflow and separately accepted PQ cohorts. An original rejected hour remains rejected.

Ordinary uses the same modified Main30 validator binary, native voting, classical signatures and default cost caps. PQ uses its experimental consensus, AUTH and configured batch limits. This is not untouched production or isolated cryptographic overhead.

Ordinary offers16k/s for600s; matched PQ offers16k/s for120s. Pressure32k/s and the predeclared PQhour8k/s are separate operating points. Different durations, sources, wire formats, genesis and history remain relevant.

Throughput spans source start through completion and drain. Resource means are duration-weighted over common offered intervals; rate divided by throughput is a proxy, not an integrated cost per transaction.

Process CPU/RSS/IO belong to the bound owned processes. Host network/disk includes original services; RX/TX across hosts double counts transfers. Summed peak RSS need not occur simultaneously. Means and nominal link capacity do not establish saturation.

PQ observed latency starts immediately after signing and before source Job queue try_send, then ends when the source processes finalized exact-ID status. It includes source queue, transport, admission, consensus and status polling; it is not strictly admission-to-finality.

System and SPL sources are reported separately. This is a simple transfer workload with a uniqueness instruction. Requested CU limits are not consumed CU measurements; ordinary votes are excluded from throughput.

Ordinary transaction bytes sum recorded wire_bytes from complete audited receipts. PQ transaction wire sizes remain unmeasured here. Serialized block payload and physical-host network traffic have different scopes.
Declared duplicate_execution_count zero is not an instrumented per-transaction execution census. Source and regression controls support promotion of the exact executed Bank.
